headline: Wardens Consolidate Weathered Expanse Amid Fierce Clashes in Linn and Nevish
war_summary: Weathered Expanse shifted from three-way parity to a solid Warden advantage over the past three hours, where six base actions brought Warden control to five strongholds against two Colonial holdings and two neutral ruins. In Linn of Mercy, unremitting combat around Lathair and Outwich Ranch yielded eight base transitions in the last two hours, with Colonials retaining ten redoubts and one neutral ground while casualties spiked sharply on both flanks. Nevish Line remains the war's deadliest sector, devouring over twenty-one hundred combined dead in two hours alone, even as strategic lines held steady at six Warden bases to two Colonial. Mooring County completed a total Warden consolidation, securing all twelve bases following the resolution of earlier clashes at The Wind Hills. To the south and west, severe attrition continues to accelerate in Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage, with thousands falling in grinding engagements, whereas the partitioned front in Marban Hollow quieted without a single base exchange since the early morning watches.
